findings.detail: The wrong idea that lost-in-the-middle effects cause the failure is a wrong option in 3 questions (S09 D, S11 A, S15 C).
The wrong idea that missing confidence scores or a confidence-based filter or threshold causes the failure is a wrong option in 3 questions (S03 B, S04 B, S09 C).
The wrong idea that adding few-shot examples fixes the failure is a wrong option in 3 questions (S07 A, S10 C, S11 D).

At least two wrong options use model self-rated confidence as a threshold or filter outside the taught calibrated review-routing use: S04 B (a self-reported confidence threshold for escalation) and S09 C (a confidence field used to filter flags). S03 B (uncalibrated field confidence that reviewers use to decide which flags to trust) is arguably a third.
